title: Super Meteor 650 Interstellar Green (Dark Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Royal Enfield Super Meteor 650 Interstellar Green (Dark Edition) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 650cc powertrain delivering 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 193 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
